verdict.rationale: Rainforest offers its own API alongside its UI surfaces. Payins, merchant onboarding and merchant updates are all documented as API-accessible, and the API is described by an OpenAPI 3.1.0 spec. However, the docs never claim full UI/API parity, and direct-API onboarding of sensitive data is limited to platforms Rainforest approves. Component Studio design and configuration is only documented as a UI workflow. missing for 10: an explicit parity statement or endpoint coverage map, API access to Component Studio and portal configuration, unrestricted API onboarding, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: Rainforest offers three options to onboard merchants: **Merchant Onboarding Component (Recommended)**... **Rainforest Platform Portal**... **Rainforest API**
Rainforest offers two options to process payins: **Payment Component (Recommended)**... **Rainforest API**
Platforms that are approved by Rainforest can send sensitive merchant onboarding data, including bank accounts and Social Security Numbers, to Rainforest via a direct to API integration.
For **Active** merchants, the deposit frequency can be updated by setting the new deposit frequency on the [Update merchant](https://docs.rainforestpay.com/reference/update_merchant) endpoint.
Rainforest supports OpenAPI Specifications (OAS) of the Rainforest API, version 3.1.0.
